extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs), science journalists, and organizations submitting news releases to EurekAlert!
extracted.subtask_description: Defines content eligibility, category definitions, and submission requirements for science news releases and related content types on the EurekAlert! platform. Summarizes what kinds of items are acceptable, visibility restrictions, and metadata/permission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-Reviewed Publications category — peer review required
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases about peer-reviewed information — be it a research study, analysis of clinical trial results, or editorial — are kept distinct in the new Peer-Reviewed Publications category. The key distinguishing factor between [Peer-Reviewed Publications] and other categories is whether the information described in the news release has completed formal peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commentary and analysis about peer-reviewed studies may only be included in this category if the commentary and analysis themselves have been peer-reviewed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports & Proceedings category — non‑peer‑reviewed but research‑based
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe research conducted through a recognized scientific process, but that is not intended for peer-reviewed publication in a scholarly journal, will now come under the new Reports & Proceedings category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This category houses news releases describing results presented at a scientific meeting or at the conclusion of a clinical trial phase, agency or government reports, white papers, survey or image analyses, non‑peer‑reviewed research-based editorials and commentaries, or new resources made available to aid scientific research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business Announcement category — transactional/non‑peer‑reviewed content
rubrics_metrics.description: This category covers information that is mainly transactional and/or not a product of peer review. It has been expanded to accept news about the scientific publishing industry, administrative or business news with societal impact, science-related public awareness initiatives and policy news, and formal position statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EurekAlert! will still require that any administrative news articulates its societal or industry-wide impact; the key question to ask is whether the news would be of interest to audiences beyond the submitting organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant and Award Announcement category — funding and nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grant and Award Announcement category combines previous categories and has expanded to include releases about the availability of funding, award nominations, and calls for applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting Announcement category — event summaries and logistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Meeting Announcement now accepts summaries of recently convened conferences and seminars, in addition to logistical and programmatic news about upcoming events, either online or in-person, where new research will be presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprints are ineligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Content solely available as a preprint, however, is still ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See EurekAlert!'s PIO Seminar about preprints for discussion on pros and cons of promoting preprints; preprint-only content cannot be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Release content type — requirements and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: You may now submit a collection of up to seven related images, audio and video clips to create a Multimedia Release. A traditional news release narrative is not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must provide multimedia rights & permissions, a brief summary and enough captions to 'tell a story' and allow staff to determine whether it meet our eligibility criteria. Multimedia Release is available to all subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Advisory content type — press‑only visibility and accepted notices
rubrics_metrics.description: The Press Conference Announcement news release category has been replaced by the Media Advisory content type. Media Advisories are only visible to journalist-members logged in to EurekAlert!, and may include details regarding upcoming news briefings and other press-only events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As part of the expansion of eligible content, Media Advisories now accept notices about expert media availability, expert lists related to breaking news, and expert Q&As. Use the 'Expert Contact' section on the news release submission form to populate expert information for reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert Contact requirement for Expert Search
rubrics_metrics.description: The new 'Expert Contact' section on the news release submission form will power the new, news-release-based Expert Search function for reporters and PIOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters should check out and fill out the Expert Contact section to enable reporters to find experts based on news releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium Content visibility and portal constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: For organizations utilizing EurekAlert!’s News Portal or Press Package services, the new platform offers three Premium Content types in support of different ways they'd like to reach intended audiences. Premium Content is only accessible via an organization’s dedicated microsite and does not pre-empt other news release content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact EurekAlert! for more information about hosting a news portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Summary — short synopses for peer‑reviewed articles (premium)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Press Summary content type is available to organizations with a News Portal or Press Package on EurekAlert!. Press Summaries are short synopses of articles either forthcoming or recently published in a peer-reviewed journal and are visible only to logged-in journalist-members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Stories — long‑form, portal‑displayed content (premium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature Stories highlight timely or 'evergreen' science-related topics, such as scientist profiles or chronicles of research projects, written in a long-form or more literary style. Feature Stories are only displayed on an organization’s dedicated News Portal, but are publicly accessible and indexed by external search engines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature Stories are not subject to EurekAlert!’s 90-day publication recency requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article Highlights — short summaries of peer‑reviewed studies (premium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Article Highlights are short summaries of peer-reviewed research studies published in a scholarly journal. They are only displayed on an organization’s dedicated News Portal and are publicly accessible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article Highlights are not subject to EurekAlert!’s 90-day publication recency requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 90‑day publication recency requirement (general rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! has a 90-day publication recency requirement that applies to news releases in general.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature Stories and Article Highlights are explicitly exempted from this 90-day recency requirement; other content types should conform to the recency rule unless otherwise noted in official guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category labeling and descriptive clarity to aid journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptive category names and their associated criteria aim to more clearly delineate content and facilitate journalists’ newsgathering efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters should choose the category that best matches the nature, source, and purpose of the content to help journalists find relevant items.
